body: Gurdeep Soni (Chairman & MD) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), volunteered: "The Q3 of the ongoing fiscal could be sequentially lower, while Q4 is expected to have the highest run rate of the fiscal. Overall, the second half of the fiscal could be flattish over the first half." Metric: Quarterly revenue shape H2 FY25. Target: Q3 < Q2; Q4 highest; H2 ~= H1 (INR ~502 cr). Deadline: 2025-03-31 (quarter). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: PARTLY. Evidence: Q3 INR 208 cr < Q2 INR 241 cr (correct). Q4 INR 253 cr below Q1 INR 261 cr (wrong). H2 INR 461 cr vs H1 INR 502 cr = -8% (missed 'flattish'). Score: 1 of 3 parts.
